summary: Iteration 4 — WebSocket chat refactor validated end-to-end. 11/11 pytest cases pass (6 WS/HTTP chat + 5 regression across auth/dashboard/questions/advisories/bookings/subjects). UI validated: /chat loads with En línea state, 5 room tabs (Comunidad UAO + 4 seed subjects), messages sent via WS appear instantly and are styled with .message.mine class (right-aligned), room switch navigates to /chat/{subject_id} and clears messages, room-specific broadcast confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~615 lines; getting close to the 700-line split threshold recommended earlier — consider extracting Chat (HTTP + WS) into its own module in the next iteration.
ConnectionManager.broadcast serializes JSON per socket; for large rooms consider building the payload once and reusing (micro-perf, non-blocking).
WS handler enforces auth via _user_from_token but only checks JWT signature/exp — no re-validation of user existence on every message (fine for MVP, but a revoked user keeps posting until reconnect).
Frontend Chat.jsx reconnect backoff caps at 6s and never gives up; acceptable but could add a visible retry counter/max-attempts UX in future.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST-prefixed messages in rooms TEST_ROOM_A, TEST_ROOM_ISO_A/B, TEST_ROOM_HTTP, plus one TEST_ws_regression question and UI_test_/UI_calc_ messages in general and a Cálculo I room. No production/seed data mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: WebSocket endpoint /api/ws/chat/{room}?token=... is registered at app-level (not APIRouter) with wss:// scheme. Verified: (a) 4401 close on missing/invalid token, (b) presence event on connect + broadcast presence when others join/leave, (c) message broadcast to all room clients incl. sender with Mongo persistence, (d) room isolation, (e) HTTP POST /api/chat also broadcasts to open WS clients (fallback path). Regression suite in same file covers auth/me, dashboard, questions create+get, advisories list/create-403, bookings list+incoming, subjects+tasks. Frontend selectors: chat-connection-state, chat-room-tabs, chat-room-general, chat-room-{subject.code}, chat-message-input, send-chat-message, chat-message-{id}. .message.mine class confirmed on own messages. Benign console warning: 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established' fires when navigating away (cleanup on unmount) — not a bug.
